create_nccl_library: create an NCCLLibrary instance to wrap the NCCL shared library for CUDA graph-compatible NCCL calls
build_nccl_communicator: build an NCCL communicator by initializing rank with a unique ID and world size
run_nccl_all_reduce: run an NCCL all-reduce operation on GPU buffers with a given data type, reduction op, and CUDA stream
test_nccl_data_type: test whether a PyTorch dtype is supported by NCCL and convert it to the corresponding NCCL data type enum
review_nccl_reduction_op: review the NCCL reduction op enum and convert a PyTorch ReduceOp to the matching NCCL reduction operation
